job.name: small-proof-film
job.prompt: A continuous restrained photorealistic six-second shot using precisely the supplied composition. Completely locked camera, identical framing and focus throughout. A minute, physically believable breeze lifts only an existing loose paper corner and gently settles it again. The existing pressed flower stays in place; the other objects never move. Preserve the exact inventory, geometry, colors and placement of the supplied scene. No new objects, people, vehicles, hands, ribbons or text. No appearance or disappearance, no morphing, no camera motion, no cut or dissolve. Material movement is subtle and slow. Return to the exact initial reference composition and lighting by the final second, then hold.
